title: Preorders For The RatKing Frames Chull Cargo Bikes Now Open
content:
The RatKing Chull is a compact steel cycle truck. This bike was originally designed for apartment living in town with its small footprint and grocery hauling capabilities. Now it’s been adapted for strolls into town, past neighbors’ cows, for post office deliveries.

The 20″ front wheel creates room for a low, frame-mounted cargo platform, while a full-size 26″ or 29″ rear wheel keeps the bike rolling easily. The rear wheel size is either/or; choose the 26″ for a shorter wheelbase or the 29″ for even better rollover. Or just go off vibes; the reverse penny farthing is a look.

The Chull uses a removable 20 × 16″ frame-mounted platform. The primary 14 × 16″ cargo area extends forward of the head tube, while another 6″ wraps rearward around it. By building the frame and platform separately, the platform is able to sit below the head tube, keeping cargo exceptionally low and stable.

The geometry is designed specifically around a loaded front platform, with a short overall wheelbase and steering intended to remain controlled and intuitive under load. (Geometry optimized for 2.25″ Tires)

The Chull is built for moderate loads (target load capacity of 75lbs). You could carry so many burritos on this thing.

The Chull’s cargo platform is not designed or intended to carry passengers, including children. The target load capacity applies to cargo only.

RatKing Chull Quick Hits

  • Price
    • Frameset (Frame, Fork, Platform, and Kickstand): $3200
    • Complete: $5800
  • Frameset Specs:
    • 20″ front wheel
    • 26″ or 29″ rear wheel
    • Clearance for up to 2.4″ Tires
  • FRAME & DRIVETRAIN:
    • 73 mm BSA bottom bracket
    • 52 mm chainline
    • 38T maximum chainring
    • 30.9 mm seatpost
    • Internal ST dropper-post routing
    • Two bottle positions on seat tube / down tube
  • AXLES & BRAKES:
    • 148 × 12 mm rear thru axle
    • 100 × 12 mm front thru axle
    • IS disc brake mounts front and rear
  • CARGO PLATFORM:
    • 20 × 16″ removable frame-mounted cargo platform (14″x16″ in front of Headtube / 6″ extension behind headtube)
    • Estimated frameset+platform weight: approximately 14 lb
    • Saddle height in reference diagrams: Small – 720mm / Big – 780mm / Bigger – 800mm
  • Tubing is a mix of straight gauge 4130 and Reynolds 631 chromoly steel tubing.
  • Timelines
    • Delivery for frames in or before Spring 2027
    • Delivery for full build Full Montys in spring 2027

Find out all the nitty-gritty details over at RatKing Frames!
